g.text: Points and bars: each arm's model-estimated mean and its 95% confidence interval (the uncertainty in the
mean, not the spread of individual values). Effects: intervention minus control in change from baseline (95%
CI). Between levels: each level's effect minus the first level's (the reference), not a test across all
